media:group.media:title: 30 Min Yoga for Athletes | Improve Mobility & Speed Up Recovery
media:group.media:description:
Build strength, improve mobility, and recover better with this 30 min yoga for athletes class designed to help reduce stiffness, increase flexibility, and support full body recovery.
This yoga practice is great for runners, surfers, lifters, cyclists, climbers, and anyone with an active lifestyle looking to improve mobility, release tight muscles, and move with more ease. If you’re feeling sore from training, workouts, or sports, this session can help improve circulation, reduce tension, and support faster recovery.
Join my mobility course on the CMC to deepen and advance you mobility practice. Try it for 1 month free with this link: https://www.timsenesiyoga.com/consciousmovement
In this 30 min full body mobility and recovery flow, we’ll focus on: • Hip mobility • Hamstring flexibility • Shoulder mobility • Spinal mobility and rotation • Lower back release • Recovery breathing and nervous system downregulation
This class is ideal as: • Post workout yoga • Recovery day movement • Athletic mobility routine • Full body stretch • Injury prevention practice
No props required, though you may want a yoga mat, block, or blanket for support.

No equipment needed. All levels welcome. Do this before: • Yoga practice • Gym or strength training • Running or cardio • Surfing or sports • Any daily movement routine

entry.title: 10 Min Hip Mobility Routine | Loosen Tight Hips & Move Better

media:group.media:title: 10 Min Hip Mobility Routine | Loosen Tight Hips & Move Better
media:group.media:description:
If your hips feel tight, stiff, or restricted, this 10 min hip mobility routine will help you create more space, strength, and ease in your body. These movements are designed to improve flexibility, build control through your range of motion, and support healthier hips for everyday life.
You can use this as a quick daily reset, before or after your workouts, or anytime your body feels like it needs to loosen up and move.
Inside this practice, you’ll work on: • Hip flexor opening • Glute and deep hip activation • Internal + external rotation • Gentle, effective mobility for long-term joint health
If you want to take this further, I have a full mobility program inside my Conscious Movement Community that will help you build lasting strength, stability, and freedom in your body. It's free to try for 30 days, and easy to cancel anytime: 👉 https://www.timsenesiyoga.com/consciousmovement

entry.title: 25 MIN MORNING YOGA FLOW | Wake Up & Feel Energized

media:group.media:title: 25 MIN MORNING YOGA FLOW | Wake Up & Feel Energized
media:group.media:description:
Start your day with this 25 min morning yoga flow designed to help you wake up your body, loosen tight muscles, and feel energized for the day ahead. This morning yoga routine will gently stretch the hips, hamstrings, spine, and shoulders while building steady breath and focus.
💥 Here is the link to join the Beginner's Fundamentals Yoga Series on the Conscious Movement Community. It's free to try for 30 days, and if you feel it's not right for you, you can cancel easily any time with just a few clicks, no questions asked: https://www.timsenesiyoga.com/consciousmovement
This class is great if you’re looking for morning yoga to wake up, a daily yoga flow, or a simple 25 min yoga practice you can do at home. Move slowly, breathe deeply, and allow the body to open gradually as you build energy for the day.
Regular morning yoga can help improve mobility, posture, and mental clarity while setting a calm and focused tone for the rest of your day.
Take your time, stay connected to your breath, and enjoy the practice. 🙏 Tim
